title: Ex-military chief Gadi Eisenkot, opponent of Netanyahu, tapped to form government
summary_full: The former military chief has 28 days to build a coalition, with a possible extension of up to 14 more. If he fails, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is likely to get his chance.
